releases.notes:
### Added
- The Prosector, the first boss. Research and make a Seer's Eye on the altar, then right click the ground anywhere in your world: the
  ground is marked ring by ring and it comes up through it. The Eye is spent. Refused on Peaceful.
- It hits hard and heals: every living Specimen gives it health back, up to its last milestone. More players make it tougher.
- What hurts it, it studies. Damage of one kind (blade, shot, blast or magic) fills that kind's sac; then it writes the kind down as a
  Specimen that hangs in the air nearby. While that jar lives the kind does little damage, and it answers with a mimic of your own
  tool, a copy of which it holds up: a giant sweep, quills fired back, a lobbed cyst, a rune circle under your feet. Break the
  jar, with anything, and it forgets and drops low and open.
- Three phases: Observation, Dissection, where hexagon cells of the ground open in patterns and throw off whoever stands on them, and
  Proof, where it hides behind a wrong-jointed copy of the player who hurt it most. Its moves all start with their own sound and show on the
  ground first, laid over the hills. Excision pays for its power by sticking its scalpel in the ground, and a raised shield snags the Retractor's hooks.
- It fights round the spot it was called to and breaks no block. Hits from outside the fight do nothing. Leaving is safe: with nobody
  left it keeps the last milestone and sleeps at that spot until someone comes near. Every number is in `hextale-prosector.toml`.
- A kill drops random loot: Riftmetal, Void Pearls, Hextech Gemstones and other high materials, something rare like a Nether Star or a
  totem, three star rune scrolls, a step in the diary and, rarely, the rune Anatomy for swords: the more of one creature kind a sword has killed, the harder it hits that kind.
- Theatre Tiles with stairs and a slab, and the Watching Eye.
- Hex Vault (research after the Hexcore, made on the Hexcore only): a store of items behind a floating door. Its gate is a
  stone platform 7 wide and 5 deep with two White Gold Pillars and a White Gold Inlay under the door. Set the vault between
  the pillars and use Hextech Dust on the gate: the vault rises and unfolds into a hexagon of six bars and six petals held by
  nothing, and it works at once. While the gate is broken a vault only gives items back.
- Items in it take no slots: each weighs its essence points, at least 1, and all share one capacity, so cheap bulk is light
  and treasure is heavy. Lamps on the frame fill with what is held, and a full vault refuses and flashes. The door parts
  for anyone who comes near, and the kinds that take up the most room drift in the space behind it. Items live with the world: a broken vault drops one item that remembers
  everything, and that item survives fire and blasts and never despawns. Hoppers, pipes and pylons use it as a normal
  inventory, a comparator reads how full it is, Jade and the goggles show the totals. Containers holding items stay out;
  4,096 kinds at most. Runes: Hoard (more room), Thrift, Mending (worn tools inside mend), Radiance (experience for new
  heights only).
- Its screen, the same at the vault, a terminal and a Pocket Terminal: the grid grows with the window up to 18 columns and
  14 rows, amounts read 1.2K and 3.4M, and tabs of the nine essences filter studied items. The search field is ready as soon
  as it opens, remembers what it held and finds names and, for studied items, essence names; sorting by count, name or
  weight, either way round. Left click takes a stack, right click half, Shift + click sends to the inventory, Shift + wheel
  moves one item out or back, a double click fills the inventory, a stack dragged onto the grid goes in, one button stores the
  inventory but not the hotbar, and a middle click or Alt + click pins an item to the row on top, where it stays with

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- Devices no longer lose everything they hold when one of the items in them cannot be read any more (for example an
  item of a mod taken out of the pack): the Crucible, the Greedy Funnel, pylon cargo, the Whirl Sawmill and the Whirl
  Reaper now lose only that one item.
- Going into the Void no longer leaves a second gate standing beside the first one on almost every trip; worlds that
  already have doubled gates lose the extra ones by themselves.
- A Crystal Battery with Thrift no longer swallows crystals without charge when several arrive at once.
- A dry or lonely Rift Gate no longer loads its partner's chunk on every tick while something stands in it.
- A broken recipe of another mod, an empty rune chapter in a loot change or a mistyped id in the diary data no longer
  crash the game or the server.
- Leaving a world no longer keeps it in memory through grapple hooks, rune and weapon effects, pylon look-ups or the
  diary map; Mirage cloaks and chalk roots no longer carry over into another world.
- Breach Hearts, Binding Chalk, Rune Chalk and the Pollen boots respect claimed land, and the Skypack drinks only from
  jars its wearer may take from.
- The Lab Bench's flame cannot be used to spam its sound, spectators cannot set stele runes, no Void Mites crawl up on
  Peaceful, and a Recall Charm used after dying no longer leads back to where the player died.
- Machine sounds stay working after the Blocks volume was turned down to nothing and up again.
- JEI lists the Research Notes of every topic instead of a single one.
- Pit Maws in newly explored parts of the Void lie in the hollow they take out of the ground instead of being buried
  in it, and exploring the Void no longer fills the log with errors about blocks set in far chunks.
### Changed
- Less load on servers and clients: busy alembics, separators, workbenches and furnaces tell players of their work at
  most twice a second, the Hex Furnace looks its recipes up only when its contents change, a pipe change no longer makes
  every pipe network of every dimension be worked out again, goggles on a pipe, ward glass and the creative search do
  less work every frame, and the haze of deep blight keeps to a budget set by the Particles option.
- Turning `thinning` off in the settings now says that it also closes the way into the Void.

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- Servers lag less with big essence stores: jars on one pipe network no longer check every other jar of it each time
  they pour, rest while nothing takes their essence, and tell the players about their contents at most twice a second.
  Four hundred jars on one network used to cost a tick of 50 ms every quarter of a second.
- A World Anchor with a Reach of three let go of only part of its chunks when broken: the outer ring stayed loaded
  until the server restarted.
- A dry Rift Gate holding an item loaded its partner's chunk every tick; gates now pay first and wait for the partner's
  chunk in the background, and a flow that nothing takes tries less and less often instead of keeping the far chunk
  loaded.
- Entering the Void or crossing it no longer stalls the server for a moment: the regions round a player are worked out
  in the background, and the Void forgets the regions nobody uses instead of all of them at once.
- The Foundry, the Crystal Battery, the Null Lantern and research boards cost less while a world runs; Rib Crawlers
  clinging under ceilings despawn like other creatures instead of piling up.
- Rune steles, the lab bench's vent and the research table's loupe can no longer be made to play their sounds over and
  over by a client sending the same thing again and again.
- A Shockwave cannot be struck by a dead player, and striking anything ends the protection of a breach being watched.
- The Void's currents and a half-made pylon link are forgotten when leaving a world.
- Pylons, the Greedy Funnel, Rift Gates and the Levitation Plate crashed the server when they put items into a
  Crucible or a Crystal Battery (and again after every restart while the pylon's cargo was in flight).
- Glowing parts of blocks and items (lamps, runes, pylon crystals, glowing veins, the glow of tools) were dark at night
  and underground.
- Void creatures showed the insides of their models from behind, and their glowing parts were overbright.
- Void Mite hearts and the shimmer veins of a drinker never showed.
- Chem vials are no longer used up in creative, and dead creatures stop walking.

Note: on Minecraft 1.21.1 HexTale's settings are kept per world, in `<world>/serverconfig/hextale-server.toml`.

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- A Rift Gate that had run dry kept saying so after its jars were filled again - even beside a Creative Essence Jar -
  until something tried to pass. It now looks into its jars by itself
  ([#5](https://github.com/Pocky-l/HexTale/issues/5)). A hungry Greedy Funnel does the same instead of waiting for the
  next death.
- The funnel's Sponge rune poured into any jar around it: a labelled jar now takes only its own essence, a Creative
  Essence Jar nothing.
- In the diary, the icons of the steps on the map showed through the window of an opened step
  ([#6](https://github.com/Pocky-l/HexTale/issues/6)); items drawn on HexTale's screens no longer show through what is
  opened over them.
- With [Spatial GUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/spatial-gui) the diary's map had see-through circles around the steps and
  a half-transparent sky ([#7](https://github.com/Pocky-l/HexTale/issues/7)): HexTale's screens left the picture
  partly transparent, which only mods that show screens in the world could see.

mods.description: Hextech magic and Chemtech mutations from the world of Arcane.

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- The Void's sky no longer jumps while you walk or run: it was painted on a box only a few blocks round the camera,
  so the bobbing of the view slid it against the world. It now hangs as far away as a sky should.
- A world no longer asks for a backup of its "experimental settings" when it opens: the game counted the Void, as
  any dimension it does not know, as experimental. HexTale's dimensions are stable now.
